component.name: GamesCard
component.script:
sub init() m.th = LumenTheme() ' Window height 344; width follows the games' 1210x342 stage at the same scale. m.AH = 344 m.scale = m.AH / LumenTheme().gameH m.AW = Int(LumenTheme().gameW * m.scale) m.W = m.AW + 24 m.H = m.AH + 64 + 12
m.fill = poster("pkg:/images/ui/card_r28.9.png", 0, 0, m.W, m.H, m.top) m.stroke = poster("pkg:/images/ui/pill_64_stroke.9.png", 0, 0, m.W, m.H, m.top) m.glass = poster("pkg:/images/ui/glass_card_r28.9.png", 0, 0, m.W, m.H, m.top)
m.games = [ { name: "Flutter", id: "bird", node: "BirdGame", icon: "bird_1.png", how: "Press OK to flap between the cypresses" } { name: "Pup Run", id: "dog", node: "DogGame", icon: "dog_run_0.png", how: "Press OK to jump the haystacks" } { name: "Star Catcher", id: "catch", node: "CatchGame", icon: "star.png", how: "Hold ‹ › to catch stars, dodge ink" } ] m.tabs = [] x = 14 for each g in m.games t = m.top.createChild("Group") t.translation = [x, 10] bg = poster("pkg:/images/ui/pill_64.9.png", 0, 0, 10, 44, t) l = t.createChild("Label") l.font = LumenFont("Manrope-ExtraBold", 20) l.text = g.name l.translation = [18, 0] l.height = 44 l.vertAlign = "center" tw = l.boundingRect().width if tw <= 0 then tw = Len(g.name) * 11 l.width = tw + 2 bg.width = tw + 36 m.tabs.Push({ bg: bg, label: l }) x = x + tw + 36 + 8 end for
m.bestL = m.top.createChild("Label") m.bestL.font = LumenFont("Manrope-ExtraBold", 20) m.bestL.horizAlign = "right" m.bestL.vertAlign = "center" m.bestL.translation = [m.W - 240 - 22, 10] m.bestL.width = 240 m.bestL.height = 44
' The game window: square-cornered, clipped. m.area = m.top.createChild("Group") m.area.translation = [12, 64] m.area.clippingRect = [0, 0, m.AW, m.AH] m.stage = m.area.createChild("Group") m.stage.scale = [m.scale, m.scale]
' HUD score with a soft shadow. m.scoreShadow = hudLabel(3) m.score = hudLabel(0)
buildCard() m.index = 0 m.game = invalid loadGame() end sub
function poster(uri as string, x as float, y as float, w as float, h as float, parent as object) as object p = parent.createChild("Poster") p.uri = uri p.translation = [x, y] p.width = w p.height = h return p end function
function hudLabel(offset as integer) as object l = m.area.createChild("Label") l.font = LumenFont("Fraunces-Display", 64) l.horizAlign = "center" l.translation = [0 + offset, 6 + offset] l.width = m.AW l.height = 80 if offset > 0 l.color = "0x00000066" else l.color = m.th.white end if return l end function
' Paper card for ready / paused / game over, centred in the window. sub buildCard() c = m.area.createChild("Group") c.translation = [(m.AW - 400) / 2, (m.AH - 262) / 2] m.card = c sheet = poster("pkg:/images/ui/sheet_r44.9.png", 0, 0, 400, 262, c) sheet.blendColor = m.th.paper m.cardIcon = poster("", 168, 18, 64, 52, c) m.cardIcon.loadDisplayMode = "scaleToFit" m.cardEyebrow = cardLabel("Manrope-ExtraBold", 16, 22, m.th.ink60) m.cardBig = cardLabel("Fraunces-Display", 72, 38, m.th.ink) m.cardTitle = cardLabel("Fraunces-Title", 32, 78, m.th.ink) m.cardLine = cardLabel("Manrope-SemiBold", 20, 126, m.th.ink60)
m.badge = c.createChild("Group") m.badge.translation = [140, 120] badgeBg = poster("pkg:/images/ui/pill_64.9.png", 0, 0, 120, 34, m.badge) badgeBg.blendColor = m.th.yellow bl = m.badge.createChild("Label") bl.font = LumenFont("Manrope-ExtraBold", 16) bl.color = m.th.ink bl.text = "NEW BEST" bl.horizAlign = "center" bl.vertAlign = "center" bl.width = 120 bl.height = 34
m.cardHint = c.createChild("Group") m.cardHint.translation = [90, 186] hintBg = poster("pkg:/images/ui/pill_64.9.png", 0, 0, 220, 52, m.cardHint) hintBg.blendColor = m.th.ink m.cardHintL = m.cardHint.createChild("Label") m.cardHintL.font = LumenFont("Manrope-ExtraBold", 20) m.cardHintL.color = m.th.white m.cardHintL.horizAlign = "center" m.cardHintL.vertAlign = "center" m.cardHintL.width = 220 m.cardHintL.height = 52 end sub
function cardLabel(font as string, size as integer, y as integer, color as string) as object l = m.card.createChild("Label") l.font = LumenFont(font, size) l.color = color l.horizAlign = "center" l.translation = [10, y] l.width = 380 l.height = size + 16 return l end function
sub loadGame() if m.game <> invalid m.game.key = "stop" m.stage.removeChild(m.game) end if g = m.stage.createChild(m.games[m.index].node) g.theme = m.top.theme g.deep = m.top.deep g.observeField("state", "refresh") g.observeField("points", "onPoints") m.game = g m.lastState = g.state m.cardIcon.uri = "pkg:/images/games/" + m.games[m.index].icon paintTabs() refresh() end sub
sub onTheme() if m.game <> invalid then m.game.theme = m.top.theme end sub
sub onDeep() if m.game <> invalid then m.game.deep = m.top.deep paint() end sub
sub onFocused() if not m.top.focused and m.game <> invalid and m.game.state = "play" then m.game.key = "pause" paint() refresh() end sub
sub onPoints() t = m.game.points.ToStr() m.score.text = t m.scoreShadow.text = t end sub
sub refresh() if m.game = invalid then return st = m.game.state g = m.games[m.index] if st = "over" and m.lastState <> "over" and m.game.points > 0 m.top.scored = { game: g.id, points: m.game.points } end if m.lastState = st onPoints() m.score.visible = (st = "play") m.scoreShadow.visible = (st = "play") m.card.visible = (st <> "play") m.badge.visible = false m.cardBig.visible = false m.cardEyebrow.visible = false m.cardIcon.visible = true m.cardTitle.visible = true if st = "over" m.cardIcon.visible = false m.cardTitle.visible = false m.cardEyebrow.visible = true m.cardEyebrow.text = "SCORE" m.cardBig.visible = true m.cardBig.text = m.game.points.ToStr() m.badge.visible = m.game.newBest if m.game.newBest m.cardLine.text = "" else m.cardLine.text = "Best " + m.game.best.ToStr() end if m.cardHintL.text = "OK Play again" else if st = "paused" m.cardTitle.text = "Paused" m.cardLine.text = "Score " + m.game.points.ToStr() m.cardHintL.text = "OK Resume" else m.cardTitle.text = g.name m.cardLine.text = g.how if m.top.focused then m.cardHintL.text = "OK Start" else m.cardHintL.text = "Select to play" end if if m.game.best > 0 then m.bestL.text = "BEST " + m.game.best.ToStr() else m.bestL.text = "" paintTabs() end sub
sub paintTabs() if m.tabs = invalid then return f = m.top.focused for i = 0 to m.tabs.Count() - 1 t = m.tabs[i] sel = (i = m.index) if sel and f t.bg.blendColor = m.th.ink t.bg.opacity = 1 t.label.color = m.th.white else if sel t.bg.blendColor = m.th.white t.bg.opacity = 0.22 t.label.color = m.th.white else t.bg.blendColor = m.th.white t.bg.opacity = 0 if f then t.label.color = m.th.ink60 else t.label.color = WithAlpha(m.th.white, 0.7) end if end for end sub
sub paint() if m.fill = invalid then return if m.top.focused m.fill.blendColor = m.th.white m.fill.opacity = m.th.focusOpacity m.stroke.visible = false m.glass.opacity = 1 m.bestL.color = m.th.ink else m.fill.blendColor = m.top.deep m.fill.opacity = m.th.frostOpacity m.stroke.visible = true m.glass.opacity = 0.55 m.bestL.color = WithAlpha(m.th.white, 0.9) end if paintTabs() end sub
' Called by MainScene while the panel has focus (presses, and "<key>_up" releases). function handleKey(key as string) as boolean st = m.game.state inRun = (st = "play" or st = "paused") if key = "OK" or key = "play" m.game.key = "OK" return true else if (key = "left" or key = "right") and not inRun d = 1 if key = "left" then d = -1 m.index = (m.index + d + m.games.Count()) mod m.games.Count() loadGame() return true else if key = "left" or key = "right" or key = "left_up" or key = "right_up" m.game.key = key return true else if key = "back" and st <> "ready" m.game.key = "stop" return true end if return false end function
